description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje komplesk te ndertuar vitet e fundit.
Ndodhet ne katin e pare banimi ne nje pike strategjithe qe mund te perdoret dhe per aktivitet biznesi.
Organizohet ne:
2 dhoma gjumi
1 sallon ndenje
2 tualete
1 ballkon
Aktualisht apartamenti eshte totalisht i arreduar ne detaje per nje jetese sa me komode.
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni!
description_en: The apartment is located in a complex built in recent years. It is located on the first floor of the residence in a strategic point that can also be used for business activities. It is organized in: 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 2 bathrooms, 1 balcony. Currently, the apartment is fully furnished in detail for a comfortable living. For a visit to the property, please contact us!
